summary: Iteration 3 focuses on the new Cash Advance (Uang Muka) feature + regression on all existing pages. Backend: added 7 new pytest cases covering full UM flow (surplus + deficit selisih auto-settle), correction & rejection paths (verifikator/atasan), draft-only delete guard, and dashboard UM counts per role. Total 26/26 tests pass. Frontend: verified sidebar shows 'Ajukan Uang Muka' (nav-um-new) and 'Uang Muka' (nav-um), /uang-muka list renders with UM rows and Bahasa Indonesia status badges (Draft UM, Menunggu Transfer, Selesai, Ditolak), /uang-muka/baru form renders with all fields + Simpan Draft & Ajukan buttons, /uang-muka/{id} detail page renders. All 16 sidebar navigations render successfully with no runtime error overlays. Fixed a real regression bug on /petty-cash (ReferenceError: rawPct is not defined) introduced by previous cleanup.

ui_bugs.issue: REGRESSION - Uncaught ReferenceError 'rawPct is not defined' (and 'surplus' undefined) at /petty-cash. Previous fix that removed stray `);` also removed `rawPct` and `surplus` definitions but left them referenced at lines 80 & 83. Whole page blank with red error overlay. FIXED by re-adding: `const rawPct = data.saldo_awal ? (data.saldo_sekarang/data.saldo_awal)*100 : 100; const pct = Math.min(100, Math.round(rawPct)); const surplus = Math.max(0, saldo_sekarang - saldo_awal);`

issues: Uses native browser <input type=date> for tanggal instead of shadcn Calendar - same locale/ dd-MM-yyyy issue previously noted for ClaimForm/Laporan. Consistency improvement.

action_items: Consider defensive coding pattern to avoid silent regressions like PettyCash 'rawPct' (e.g., enable ESLint no-undef rule in the repo so referencing an undeclared variable fails the build).
Replace native date pickers on UangMukaForm and RealizeDialog with shadcn Calendar to match app locale (id-ID, dd/MM/yyyy).

Cash Advance detail page timeline currently only shows 'created' when no submit/verify actions yet; verify action buttons are correctly shown to the appropriate role at each status (spot-checked admin sees Edit/Hapus/Ajukan on DRAFT_UM - OK).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now 1108 lines; strongly recommend splitting into routers/ (claims, cash_advances, topups, users, files, dashboard, reports) - single-file server is becoming unmanageable.

petty cash mutations across cash-advance transfer/confirm are not wrapped in a MongoDB transaction. A crash between apply_petty_cash and status update can leave inconsistent state (same issue as claims/topups).

Cash Advance 'confirm' checks `abs(selisih) > 0.01` for float comparison - reasonable, but persisted `selisih` and `jumlah_um`/`jumlah_aktual` are stored as float. For money, prefer storing as integer rupiah (Rp is integer-only) to avoid drift. All API expects float; consider migrating to int in a future refactor.
Same useEffect anti-pattern was fixed in iteration_2; PettyCash regression here shows the fragility of hand-edits on this file. Add unit test / smoke render test for PettyCash page.
ca_verify/ca_approve return HTTP 400 for both 'not found' and 'wrong status' (line 820, 839). Should return 404 for not-found and 409/400 for status mismatch to help API consumers debug.

Cash Advance realize endpoint doesn't cap jumlah_aktual to any upper limit - a user could enter jumlah_aktual = 10x jumlah_um and force a giant deficit. Consider adding a sanity guard or requiring atasan re-approval when deficit > X% of UM.

rca of the issue: PettyCash.jsx regression RCA: When iteration_2 fix removed stray `);` `}` tokens at line 135-136, the surrounding variable declarations `rawPct` and `surplus` were also removed but the JSX at lines 80 & 83 still references them. React threw 'ReferenceError: rawPct is not defined' during render, blanking the entire /petty-cash route. Reproduction: navigate to /petty-cash - red overlay 'Uncaught runtime errors'. Mitigation: reintroduced the three variable declarations (rawPct, pct, surplus) with sensible defaults. Verified /petty-cash now renders saldo card + progress bar + Riwayat Mutasi table without errors.
